info.title: viggle/jst-2-scene
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "viggle/jst-2-scene", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: JSON body of a JST-2 scene. Send `prompt` (with optional `referenceImages` and `quality`) or `panoramaUri`, not both.

example.prompt: a sunlit atrium with tall plants and a stone floor

panoramaUri.description: http(s) URL of a 360° panorama to build the scene from.

quality.description: Panorama quality: low (the default), medium or high. Only with `prompt`.

referenceImages.description: Up to 8 http(s) image URLs that guide the panorama. Only with `prompt`.

sessionId.description: Session that holds the scene: 1 to 128 letters, digits, `_` or `-`. Use a new random value for each scene.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for Viggle JST-2 scenes: the terminal `GET /proxy/viggle/v1/scenes/{task_id}` task, forwarded unchanged. A `viggle/jst-2-scene` task carries the Gaussian-splat scene at `result.spz.url`, the panorama at `result.panorama.url` and the views at `result.outputBatch.views[].url`; a `viggle/jst-2-scene-view` task carries only its new views. The URLs are Viggle's and expire after 3 hours; poll the task again for fresh ones. Pass `result.outputBatch.batchId` in `referenceBatchIds` to generate more views of the same session.

ViggleError.description: Viggle's error object, set when the job failed.

ViggleSceneOutputBatch.description: The image batch the task added to the session.

ViggleSceneResult.description: The scene output, set only when the task is ready.

credits.description: Viggle credits the task is charged; 0 once a task that did not finish ready is refunded.

operation.description: Task kind: pano, generate or reconstruct.

queuePosition.description: Tasks ahead of this one while it is queued.

status.description: Status: queued, processing, ready, failed or cancelled.

url.description: Download URL of the view image, valid for 3 hours.
